claims.quote: Acanthopsoides robertsi is a dwarf horse-face loach from the Kapuas River basin in West Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo.
Described from the Kapuas River basin in Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan) province, Indonesian Borneo where it occurs alongside the congener A. molobrion.
